messages:
emma-docs: opened PR #4120 to convert audit-log examples to JSONL, add Node/Python snippets, and a tiny migration checklist (v0.x -> v1.x). draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/4120

henry-legal: quick ask: avoid absolutes in SOC2 wording. replace 'we never share logs' with 'access is restricted and governed by contract and policy'. also don't publish fixed retention promises.

maya-privacy: add a short demo-data note: remove PII but keep required keys with placeholders (e.g., "actor":"<REDACTED>"). link to internal privacy playbook.

leo-devex: snippets look good. two small fixes: Node should use console.log(JSON.stringify(r)) to emit newline-delimited JSON; Python should print(json.dumps(r)) per record. sample:
```
for r in records:
    print(json.dumps(r))
```

gio-infra: CI schema validator flagged example 4: missing event_id. if redacting, please keep key with placeholder. I'll add a test that validates example JSONL against the schema.

ci-bot: CI / docs-lint \u2014 failed: examples/audit-log/jsonl -> record 4 missing required 'event_id'. Triggered by PR #4120

emma-docs: swapping omitted fields to placeholders now and adding an MDX note titled 'Redaction vs schema' that lists which fields are required for API ingestion vs which can be removed for demos. also fixing internal link /legal/retention -> /legal/data-retention.

henry-legal: add export/legal-hold contact line: 'For exports or legal holds, contact legal@redwood.ai with the case ID and requester details.' keep it short.

ci-bot: CI / docs-lint \u2014 all checks passed.

zoe-product: great. i'll include a brief changelog bullet about JSON -> JSONL and the client API rename in the release highlights.

emma-docs: merged. closing thread — thanks everyone!
